definitions.gloss: to revive, to come back to life
definitions.explanation: To return to life or consciousness after appearing to be dead or exhausted.

definitions.gloss: to be refreshed, to feel revitalized
definitions.explanation: To regain energy and feel rejuvenated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The flower came back to life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: Old traditions came back to life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やったら→やる：02980_yaru⟧、⟦{枯|か}れかけた→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The tree that was nearly dead came back to life after I watered it.

Drinking a cold beer on a hot day makes me feel revived.

examples.english: I was tired from walking all day, but I felt revived after getting into the hot spring.

notes:
{生|い}き{返|かえ}る means to revive or feel refreshed, literally "return to living."

FORMS:
⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (to live) + ⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ (to return)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Transitive pair: {生|い}き{返|かえ}らせる (to revive something)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生|い}き{返|かえ}る: to feel revived by cold water
- {生|い}き{返|かえ}った⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧: feeling refreshed
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|い}き{返|かえ}る: traditions come back to life

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{蘇|よみがえ}る→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧: to be revived, resurrected (more literary)
